moments.title: The Hundred 2026 Crowns Champions
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament concluded on Sunday, August 16th, with Manchester Super Giants winning the men's title and Trent Rockets taking the women's trophy.

angles.name: Men's Final
angles.copy: What a finish to The Hundred! Manchester Super Giants are your 2026 men's champions after a thrilling final on Sunday. Cricket's short-form spectacle delivered again!

angles.name: Women's Final
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Trent Rockets, who dominated to win The Hundred 2026 women's final on Sunday! What a performance.

moments.title: ArcTanGent Festival Kicks Off Today
moments.blurb: The ArcTanGent Festival, celebrating experimental and heavy music, begins today in Compton Martin, UK, running until Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Festival start
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious riffs! ArcTanGent Festival kicks off today in Compton Martin, bringing four days of the best in experimental and heavy music.

angles.name: Heavy music vibes
angles.copy: Calling all Nation Rocks listeners! ArcTanGent is ON, delivering the heaviest sounds and most innovative artists right now. Who are you seeing?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Begins Tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, a beloved independent music and arts event, starts tomorrow in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, running until Sunday, August 23rd.

angles.name: Festival preview
angles.copy: The magic of Green Man Festival returns to the Brecon Beacons tomorrow! Who's heading to Wales for a weekend of incredible music and arts?

angles.name: Local Welsh angle
angles.copy: Dust off your wellies! Green Man Festival is back in the Brecon Beacons from tomorrow. Excited for a fantastic Welsh weekend of music and culture?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Kicks Off Tomorrow
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating genre-hopping music, wellness, and culture, begins tomorrow in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, running until August 23rd. Note: The festival is sold out for 2026.

angles.name: Festival start - sold out
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off tomorrow in Dorset, bringing four days of incredible dance, soul, hip hop, and jazz. If you've got tickets, you're one of the lucky ones – it's sold out!

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's festival
angles.copy: Curated by Gilles Peterson, We Out Here Festival starts tomorrow! Expect the best in genre-defying music and a vibrant community atmosphere.

moments.title: All Points East Begins Friday
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival returns to Victoria Park, London, this Friday, August 21st, for an extended run of events until August 30th.

angles.name: London festival start
angles.copy: Victoria Park is calling! All Points East kicks off this Friday for another massive series of shows. Who are you heading to East London to see?

angles.name: Weekend festival hype
angles.copy: Your weekend plans are sorted! All Points East brings the best in music back to London starting this Friday. Get ready!

moments.title: Rewind Festival South This Weekend
moments.blurb: Rewind Festival South, the popular 80s and 90s music festival, takes place this weekend, August 21st-23rd, in Henley-On-Thames.

angles.name: 80s/90s festival hype
angles.copy: Get ready to rewind! Rewind Festival South is this weekend in Henley-On-Thames, bringing back all your favourite 80s and 90s anthems. Who's in?

angles.name: Nostalgia trip
angles.copy: Your ultimate 90s throwback is happening this weekend! Rewind Festival South is bringing the biggest hits and artists to Henley. What 90s track are you hoping to hear?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue New Chart Entry
moments.blurb: Pop icons Madonna and Kylie Minogue have entered the Official UK Singles Chart at number 8 with their new collaboration 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: New entry hype
angles.copy: Two legends, one massive track! Madonna and Kylie Minogue have officially landed at Number 8 on the UK Singles Chart with 'Love Sensation'. What a collaboration!

angles.name: Iconic pop duo
angles.copy: Madonna AND Kylie?! Yes please! The pop queens have teamed up for 'Love Sensation' and it's already a Top 10 hit. Feels like the 80s all over again!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Countdown
moments.blurb: The countdown to Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is on, with the launch show confirmed for Saturday, September 19th, and new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Launch date excitement
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is officially back on September 19th for its launch show. Who's excited for the new series and fresh faces?

angles.name: New hosts reveal
angles.copy: New era, new hosts! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking the reins on Strictly Come Dancing this year. What do you think of the line-up?

moments.title: Ian Gillan of Deep Purple is 81 Today
moments.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to Ian Gillan, the legendary frontman of rock band Deep Purple, born today in 1945.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Ian Gillan, legendary voice of Deep Purple! Turn up 'Smoke on the Water' today!

angles.name: Rock icon
angles.copy: An icon turns 81 today! Happy Birthday to Deep Purple's Ian Gillan, whose vocals defined a generation of rock. What's your favourite Deep Purple track?

moments.title: John Deacon of Queen is 75 Today
moments.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to John Deacon, the iconic bassist and songwriter of rock legends Queen, born today in 1951.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: A very Happy 75th Birthday to the brilliant John Deacon of Queen! The man behind some of rock's greatest basslines and hits. What's your favourite Queen song he wrote?

angles.name: Queen's bassist
angles.copy: Celebrating John Deacon's 75th birthday today! The legendary Queen bassist gave us unforgettable tracks like 'Another One Bites the Dust'.

moments.title: Shaun Ryder of Happy Mondays is 64
moments.blurb: Happy 64th birthday on August 23rd to Shaun Ryder, the charismatic frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, born in 1962.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Madchester icon Shaun Ryder turns 64 on Friday! Happy Birthday to the Happy Mondays and Black Grape legend. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Manchester legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to Shaun Ryder this Friday! The Manchester legend behind Happy Mondays and Black Grape.

moments.title: Elvis Costello Turns 72
moments.blurb: The influential English singer-songwriter Elvis Costello celebrates his 72nd birthday on Sunday, August 25th, born in 1954.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday on Sunday to the brilliant Elvis Costello! An absolute songwriting legend. What's your top track from him?

angles.name: Music legend
angles.copy: From 'Watching the Detectives' to 'Oliver's Army', Elvis Costello turns 72 this Sunday! Celebrate the punk and new wave icon.

moments.title: Shirley Manson of Garbage is 60
moments.blurb: Happy 60th birthday on Monday, August 26th, to Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish singer and frontwoman of the band Garbage, born in 1966.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage on Monday! Still rocking harder than anyone. What's your favourite Garbage track?

angles.name: Scottish icon
angles.copy: Happy 60th to Scotland's own rock queen, Shirley Manson of Garbage, this Monday! An absolute legend.

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: The Queen of Country Pop, Shania Twain, celebrates her 61st birthday on Wednesday, August 28th, born in 1965.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain this Wednesday! Let's go girls, celebrate the Queen of Country Pop!

angles.name: Country Pop Queen
angles.copy: That don't impress us much... unless it's Shania Twain's 61st birthday this Wednesday! What's your favourite 90s Shania hit?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just around the corner, falling on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Long weekend anticipation
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is on Monday 31st. How are you planning to make the most of it?

angles.name: Planning for the break
angles.copy: Not long now until the August Bank Holiday on Monday 31st! Perfect for a last summer hurrah across Wales. What are your plans?
